title: Tutte's 4-Flow Conjecture for Petersen-Minor-Free Graphs
exact_target: Can every graph with no bridge and no Petersen graph minor carry a nonzero integer flow of absolute value less than four on every edge?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1444 (GRAPH-057). CC BY 4.0.
József Pintér, Nowhere-Zero 4-Flows in Graphs Excluding a Proper Minor of the Petersen Graph, arXiv:2607.22267v2 (2026), abstract and Sections 1--2.
